findings.issue: The 150 ms search debounce timer is never cancelled when the home page is navigated away from; if the user types and then clicks a card within the window, the timer fires `update()` which `history.replaceState`s the home filter URL (e.g. `/?q=pika`) while the Pokémon page is on screen.
findings.suggestion: Cancel the timer when the page is discarded — e.g. extend `Page` (app/src/components.ts:7-11) with a `teardown` called from `render()` in app/src/main.ts:33 before replacing content, and `clearTimeout(searchTimer)` there.

findings.issue: On popstate the browser restores scroll synchronously ('auto' restoration) but the content is replaced asynchronously, so back/forward to long lists can land at the wrong scroll offset.
findings.suggestion: Capture `location.href` on popstate and scroll to the stored/hash position after `replaceChildren`, or set `history.scrollRestoration = 'manual'` and manage it explicitly.

findings.issue: A `page` parameter beyond the last page is clamped for display but left stale in the URL, and pagination links are built from the clamped value — URL and view disagree.
findings.suggestion: When `filters.page > totalPages`, redirect/replace the URL with the clamped page.

findings.issue: The error page's `Try again` link uses `href: location.href`; the global click handler (app/src/main.ts:53-62) intercepts it and pushes a duplicate history entry instead of actually retrying a full load.
findings.suggestion: Use a `reload` action (e.g. an `onClick` that calls `location.reload()`) or bypass the link interceptor for self-referential links.

findings.issue: Every deep-link HTML request performs a blocking API probe (up to 3 s timeout) just to decide the 404 status, adding latency to all page loads.
findings.suggestion: Memoise the probe per (resource, name) for the process lifetime, or drop it and serve 200 always — the spec says the status isn't tested.

findings.issue: Selecting a game issues one parallel request per distinct move (~100 for a modern game) with no concurrency limit.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable given the in-flight dedupe cache (app/src/api.ts:114-120), but a small batched limiter would smooth the burst; at minimum note the intent in a comment.

summary: A clean, framework-free Vite 8/TypeScript 7 SPA with genuinely small, well-bounded modules and correct handling of the spec's fiddliest rules (alternate forms, humanized vs English names, sortable tables, aria-sort). The one merge blocker is a leaked debounce timer on the home page that can clobber the URL after navigation; everything else is nits. I'd approve after that one localised fix.
